visual_review.method: Compared every visible entity, package label, printed stereotype, relationship endpoint, literal end label and hollow-triangle inheritance marker against the complete source artwork. Checked the ClearingMemberRole self-loop at rendered full resolution. Long outer associations, parallel account relationships and source-omitted stereotypes are retained. No numerical multiplicities are printed. Re-layout differs; native SVG remains zoomable.
